status_summary: EO 14332 (signed 2025-08-07) directed the OMB Director to revise the Uniform Guidance (2 CFR part 200) to require termination-for-convenience in discretionary grants and to limit facilities and administrative costs. OMB, with more than 40 co-signing agencies and offices, published a proposed rule on 2026-05-29 (Regulation for Federal Financial Assistance, 91 FR 32198) that would revise part 200 broadly; comments closed 2026-07-13, and a law firm analysis reports an intended effective date of 2026-10-01 and that OMB declined to address indirect cost rates, although the notice's own table of contents includes an Indirect Cost Rates section. No final rule was found in the Federal Register as of 2026-10-16, so nothing is yet operative. No OMB action on the Information Quality Act, Paperwork Reduction Act or Privacy Act was found.

timeline.event: EO 14332 signed, directing OMB to revise the Uniform Guidance.
OMB and co-signing agencies published a proposed rule to revise 2 CFR part 200.
Comment period closed on the proposed rule.
